messages:
mina: quick note while onboarding voyager-v1 -> int8: found a deterministic detok oddity. when a Chinese quoted phrase follows an Arabic chunk the CJK corner quotes flip. float32 decode is correct.

lee: paste smallest repro + tokenizer? staging only?

mina: tokenizer=voyager-sp. repro on local int8 and staging. smallest failing string: Arabic + CJK quoted phrase.

mina: repro snippet:
Translate to zh: "He said \"Good morning\" in Arabic: \u0635\u0628\u0627\u062d"
int8 decode shows: corner quotes swapped around CJK phrase.

yusuf: if token ids match float32 then likely detok table or fused kernel reordering under rtl flag. bisecting detok_fuse changes now.

ci-bot: quick smoke: 200 mixed-locale samples -> chrF 0.78 -> 0.72, failures concentrated on CJK-after-RTL cases. artifact: /runs/2791234567/voyager-int8-smoke

mina: switching detok table to table_v2 fixes decode on int8, so interaction table_v3 + detok_fuse_v2 is suspect.

sasha: plan: hotfix to force table_v2 for has_rtl on int8 canary -> bisect+revert offending change -> add unit/regression test for mixed-orientation quoted phrases -> staged rollout. assigning @yusuf to PR and @lee to post-patch evals.

infra-bot: canary deploy started at 2791234800

yusuf: bisect pointed to new reorder logic in detok_fuse_v2 commit 9b7e1c. opening revert PR and adding token roundtrip test.

mina: will validate canary and rerun smoke once hotfix is live. keeping thread updates here.
